thesis: No new-entry capacity route, so new entrants rely on day-ahead revenue while the capacity framework is unsettled, and every ungranted design loses value at the platform's yields. Two cohorts are separate investments: a project in the 2025 grant cohort is the exception and carries its own call, and an asset holding an earlier seventeen-year contract is worth pricing only below replacement cost.
没有新进入的容量路径，因此在容量机制尚未确定时，新进入者依靠日前市场收入，所有无补贴设计按本平台收益率均损失价值。两个批次属于不同投资：2025年补贴批次中的项目是例外，并有其独立结论；持有早期十七年合同的资产，只值得以低于重置成本的价格定价。

reason: Seventh of fifteen markets on the design grid's hold IRR, 7.4% (23 October 2026).
按设计表测算的持有期IRR为7.4%（2026年10月23日），在十五个市场中排第七。
assetReturn.author: analyst

reason: The statute sets the fee, the advance, the security and a deadline of 120 to 150 days for an operator to issue connection conditions, and says when a refused applicant is repaid. No single public register follows a storage project from application to operation.
法律明确规定了申请费、预付款、履约担保，以及运营商出具并网条件的120至150日期限，并规定了申请被拒时的退款方式。但没有一个统一的公开登记册能够跟踪储能项目从申请到投运的全过程。
approvalTransparency.author: analyst

reason: Review reaches an investor from outside the member states acquiring 20% or control of a company that generates electricity and had revenue in Poland above EUR 10 million; a preliminary proceeding takes 30 working days and a full one up to 120 days, which is longer than ninety.
审查适用于成员国以外的投资者收购发电企业20%股权或取得其控制权、且该企业在波兰的营业收入超过1,000万欧元的情形；初步审查为30个工作日，正式审查最长120日，超过九十天。
foreignEntry.author: analyst

trendCause: The availability factor applied to storage in the capacity auction was cut from 95% to about 60% and then to 13.39% in successive auctions, and no main auction is planned for 2026.
容量拍卖中适用于储能的可用性修正系数在连续几轮拍卖中由95%降至约60%，再降至13.39%，且2026年不计划举行主拍卖。
reason: The December 2025 auction was the last main-auction route and its successor framework has no settled design; the factor that sets what a battery is paid for capacity changed sharply between consecutive auctions.
2025年12月的拍卖是最后一轮主拍卖，接续框架的方案尚未确定；决定电池容量收入的修正系数在相邻两轮拍卖之间大幅变动。
policyStability.author: analyst

where: Cooperation on an existing eligible grant project
既有合资格补贴项目的合作开发

text: The grant-supported reference case remains below the strategic target. A small shortfall is not a tolerance, and any net synergy must be separately evidenced.
含补贴的参考情景仍低于战略投资者目标；较小差距不构成容忍区间，任何净协同收益均须另行举证。
Fair evidence: verify the target grant, eligible costs, payment timing and change-of-control conditions; the existing cohort does not prove a new greenfield project can obtain support.
证据一般：核实目标补贴、合格成本、支付时间和控制权变更条件；既有批次不能证明新绿地项目可获得补贴。
At the November checkpoint identify an executable cooperation route and quantify net synergies and delivery costs. At the January stop review, absent target and terms require a scoped Pass proposal.
11月复核时明确可执行合作路径，量化净协同收益和交付成本；1月截止复核时仍无目标及条款，则提交范围限定的放弃建议。

despite: A verified grant project with executable cost advantages may justify a new valuation; no synergy or grant is added merely by keeping Watch.
补贴经核实且具可执行成本优势的项目可重新估值；保留观察不会自动新增协同收益或补贴。
strategic.author: analyst
scoreNote: Market fit is not project value. Watch requires grant/transaction evidence and a return recheck.
市场适配不等于项目价值；观察等待补贴和交易证据及回报复核。

text: An uncontracted four-hour project loses value on the model at the platform's yields.
未签约的四小时项目按模型测算、按本平台收益率会损失价值。
The reference project secures nothing; batteries that won long capacity contracts in earlier auctions are a different cohort.
参考项目没有任何锁定收入；在早先拍卖中取得长期容量合同的电池项目属于另一批次。
The capacity credited to storage was cut sharply between auctions, and no successor to the main auction is settled.
储能的容量核定系数在相邻拍卖之间被大幅下调，主拍卖的接续机制也尚未确定。

despite: A project holding one of the earlier seventeen-year capacity contracts can be worth buying at the right price.
持有早先十七年期容量合同的项目，在价格合适时仍值得收购。

提交申请时即须预缴最高600万兹罗提，此时并网条件尚未出具。

容量市场主拍卖的接续机制完成立法
Analyst checkpoint: grant project and terms
分析师复核：补贴项目及条款
note: Internal checkpoint, not an official award date. Obtain grant/payment/transfer evidence and executable cost and contract terms. At the 31 January 2027 stop review, no identifiable target and executable terms means submit Pass for this route; any change requires analyst approval.
此为内部复核日，并非官方授予日期。取得补贴、支付、转让证据及可执行成本和合同条款。2027年1月31日截止复核时，如仍无明确目标和可执行条款，提交该路线的放弃建议；任何判断变更均须分析师批准。

label: Capacity market · 4h
容量市场 · 4小时
why: Four hours on an earlier seventeen-year capacity contract is the engine's best design, and it still loses value at the platform's yields; an uncontracted four-hour project does worse.
持有早期十七年容量合同的四小时设计是引擎的最佳设计，但按本平台收益率仍损失价值；无合同的四小时项目更差。

text: Wait for a successor to the main auctions; until then, price only assets holding an earlier seventeen-year contract, and only below replacement cost.
等待主拍卖的后继机制；在此之前，只对持有早期十七年合同的资产定价，且仅以低于重置成本的价格。

label: Grant-funded merchant · 4h
获补贴市场化 · 4小时
why: Grant assumed; verify award, payment and any capacity-payment deduction.
补贴为假设；须核实授予、支付及适用的容量付款扣减。

text: Fund/strategic Watch: verify grant and target terms on 30 November; propose scoped Pass if absent on 31 January. No automatic extension.
基金和战略投资者观察：11月30日核实补贴及项目条款；1月31日仍缺失则提交该范围的放弃建议，不自动顺延。

where: An existing project with a valid grant and transferable rights
持有效补贴且权利可转让的既有项目

text: The grant is already included in the reference case, which remains below the fund target. A future grant confirmation is not additional model income.
参考情景已计入补贴，仍低于基金目标；未来确认补贴不构成额外模型收入。
Fair evidence: the programme exists, but a ranking does not prove the target grant, payment or transfer consent. Check the target award date and completion obligations.
证据一般：补贴计划存在，但排名不能证明目标项目已获补贴、支付或转让同意；须核实实际授予日期和完工义务。

Obtain the target agreement, costs, revenue terms, financing and exit evidence at the November checkpoint. If no target and executable terms exist by the January stop review, submit a scoped Pass decision.
在11月复核时取得目标协议、成本、收入条款、融资和退出证据。1月截止复核时仍无目标和可执行条款，则提交范围限定的放弃决定。

despite: A valid-grant project with better executable terms could justify a fresh valuation. The reference rights price is already zero; construction remains payable.
具有效补贴和更优可执行条款的项目可重新估值；参考项目权利价格已为零，建设支出仍需支付。
